file04StateClasses.role: Live bytes. Four named classes: Authoritative evidence; Analysis-affecting durable state; Rebuildable cache/index; Operational metadata. Every component manifest declares its state class, owner, writer, schema, migration, retention, backup, purge, and recovery contract. Cross-class writes, cache-to-authority promotion, undeclared Plan inputs, and component evidence commits are negative tests under DR-124 and DR-G19. This specification consumes those bytes as law for exact-byte intent. It does not rewrite those bytes. It does not settle the two OUT classes as preview-designable.

d002.role: Platforms: macOS (arm64, x86_64) and Linux (x86_64, arm64). Windows deferred with explicit disposition. Language roles: TypeScript, alone. State: local, non-authoritative only — rebuildable cache/index and operational metadata classes (DR-124), plus doctor/purge honesty (DR-G12). Authoritative sealed closure, replay, and evidence custody are OUT of slice 1. DR-106, DR-109, and DR-113 are deferred WHOLLY. G19 is in the required-now set for touched classes. This specification does not extend the class list and does not invent a sealed-Run class.

namedCorpusClasses.exactByteIntent: Once authored: one cell per included preview state-class (Rebuildable cache/index, Operational metadata) and per lifecycle operation in the slash-joined set {migration, backup, purge, recovery}, on each D-002 platform. Each cell retains the seven first-group live-cell members for that class × operation, bound to that class's declared owner and writer. Authoritative evidence is not a cell. Analysis-affecting durable state is not a cell. A sealed-Run class is not a cell. Purge cells retain declaration and in-class scope only; they do not author a purge recipe, D9 code, exit number, or PURGED typed result. Migration and recovery cells retain in-class declaration; they do not author G18 journal write/fsync/rename/pointer crash corpus or G11 custody recovery. Backup cells retain class-preserving backup/restore declaration; they do not author storage-mechanics recipes. Fixtures are unauthored.
namedCorpusClasses.passProperty: Every included-class × {migration, backup, purge, recovery} cell is present on all four D-002 platforms. A skipped class, operation, or platform is not a waiver. OUT classes are not cells. Windows is not a cell. G12, G18, and G11 are not scored.

namedCorpusClasses.exactByteIntent: Once authored: per D-002 platform, digest-pinned refused writes among the two included classes and from either included class toward Authoritative evidence, covering file 04's four named negative tests as they apply to preview classes: cross-class writes, cache-to-authority promotion, undeclared Plan inputs, and component evidence commits. A cache or operational-metadata byte is not treated as sealed evidence. A preview analyze terminal result labeled a sealed Run is G27 and is not this class. Fixtures are unauthored.
namedCorpusClasses.passProperty: A writer of one included class cannot commit into the other included class's store. Neither included class becomes Authoritative evidence by copy, rename, or citation. An undeclared Plan input fails. A component evidence commit fails. Treating cache or operational metadata as sealed evidence fails. G27 is not scored. Pass all four D-002 platforms.

A preview analyze terminal result is not this member (G27). Fixtures are unauthored.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Cache does not change semantic result. Operational metadata does not enter Plan/Run. A promotion invented here fails. Labeling either included class sealed Run/evidence fails. G27 is not scored. Pass all four D-002 platforms × both included classes.
